subject: The secret workflow 99% of SoulPlan users miss
preview_text: I wasn't going to share this, but our top 1% of couples use the app in a way that changes everything.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. For months, I watched our analytics and saw something weird. A tiny group of users—the top 1%—were getting results that blew everyone else out of the water. More dates planned, way more 'wow' moments, and their Date History was a treasure trove. I had to know their secret.

Turns out, they don't just use the app when they're bored on a Tuesday. They have a system. Every Sunday, they sit down for 10 minutes together. They open the AI generator, feed it one new interest they've each mentioned that week, and let it suggest three wildcard ideas. They don't just save them to a wishlist; they immediately schedule one for the coming week right in the app. This tiny ritual is their relationship hack.

This is the power of the 'Schedule a Date' feature combined with proactive AI prompts. The top users treat the AI not as a last-resort idea machine, but as a weekly creative partner. They input fresh, tiny details ('just tried Korean BBQ,' 'watched a documentary about volcanoes'), and it connects dots they'd never see. Then, they commit by scheduling it. This turns vague 'someday' dreams into next Friday's plan.

Your move? This Sunday, open SoulPlan together. Go to the AI generator and type in one new, small thing you each enjoyed this week. Schedule the most surprising idea it gives you. Do this just once, and you'll see why the top 1% never run out of spark. P.S. The couples who do this have a 92% higher 'date density'—they're literally building more memories, faster. Don't let your next great date stay a wishlist item.
